name: qa-desktop
description: Desktop application testing for Windows (FlaUI, WinAppDriver), Electron (Playwright) and Qt (Qt Test), with a driver decision table. Also covers Linux AT-SPI, Spectron migration, and a test-review hazard checklist. An authoring agent (desktop-test-author) detects the driver, scaffolds a test project when none exists, and writes per-flow tests. macOS XCTest UI tests live in qa-mobile.
